name: Mydrannul
summary: At the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus, Mydrannul keeps basic supplies ready for sentinels, soldiers, and visitors.

sections.title: Supplies of the Warrior's Terrace
sections.body: Mydrannul keeps a supply stall among the Warrior's Terrace military pavilions and training grounds. Darnassus's defenders and travelers can find everyday field gear there, including ammunition for archers and gunners, throwing blades, flint, pouches, and simple rations. His stall helps sentinels and trainees preparing for duty on Teldrassil find the basic sundries they need.

faq.answer: Mydrannul can be found in the Warrior's Terrace, Darnassus's southeastern martial district on the crown of Teldrassil.
Mydrannul sells containers, simple rations, drink, flint and tinder, throwing weapons, arrows, and bullets.
Yes. Mydrannul sends adventurers to his friend Nessa Shadowsong, a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village, who needs a parcel carried to Darkshore.

angles.text: As a night elf training in Darnassus, you can find everyday equipment and arrows from Mydrannul to keep Sentinels supplied.
As an Alliance traveler arriving on Teldrassil, you can rely on vendors like Mydrannul in the Warrior's Terrace for basic packs, ammunition, and field rations.
